# Brain Creator Documentation

> Brain Creator is a requirement-driven, agent-native testing brain for Claude Code and Codex.

## Start here

- [Documentation home](README.md): Choose a task-oriented path through the Brain Creator documentation.
- [Quickstart](getting-started.md): Install Brain Creator, verify the runtime, and produce the first reviewable requirement analysis.
- [Core concepts](core-concepts.md): Understand Requirement Brain, System Brain, case compilation, test data, execution plans, Bugs, Gaps, and Agent providers.

## 简体中文

- [中文文档首页](zh-CN/index.md): 按任务选择 Brain Creator 中文指南。
- [中文快速开始](zh-CN/getting-started.md): 安装、诊断并完成第一次需求分析。
- [中文核心概念](zh-CN/core-concepts.md): 理解 Requirement Brain、System Brain、执行计划、Bug 与 Gap。
- [中文需求到测试](zh-CN/guides/requirement-to-test.md): 从需求来源完成审批、系统绑定、数据准备、执行和复盘。
- [中文可信控制面](zh-CN/guides/trusted-control-plane.md): 使用 Facade 完成鉴权验证、批量编译、页面绑定和 Gap 生命周期。
- [中文存储与证据](zh-CN/guides/storage-and-evidence.md): 理解 schema 21 分片仓库、评估完整性、迁移、manifest、doctor 检查和 Suite 导出。
- [中文 CLI 参考](zh-CN/cli-reference.md): 查询统一命令、参数和环境变量。

- [中文故障排查](zh-CN/troubleshooting.md): 按症状解决安装和执行问题。
- [中文会话恢复](zh-CN/e2e-session-resume-workflow.md): 在新 Agent 会话中恢复持久状态并继续正确任务。

## Guides

- [Requirement to test](guides/requirement-to-test.md): Take an approved requirement through system binding, evidence collection, data preparation, execution, and review.
- [Trusted control plane](guides/trusted-control-plane.md): Use bounded Facade responses, verified auth, batch compilation, confirmed page bindings, and auditable Gap transitions.
- [Storage and evidence](guides/storage-and-evidence.md): Understand schema 21 migration, evaluation integrity, sharded storage, manifests, doctor checks, and Suite export.
- [Agent usage](agent-usage.md): Use natural-language entrypoints and understand Facade approval behavior.
- [Session resume workflow](e2e-session-resume-workflow.md): Restore a persisted Brain Creator workflow in a new Agent session.
- [v2 low-level quickstart](v2-quickstart.md): Inspect internal and compatibility `bc_*` workflows.

## Reference

- [CLI reference](cli-reference.md): Look up consolidated commands, options, environment variables, and compatibility executables.
- [MCP installation](mcp-installation.md): Configure Claude, Codex, host-agent, the Codex plugin, and MCP transport.
- [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md): Diagnose installation, provider, browser, authentication, connector, evidence, and execution problems by symptom.
- [Release checklist](release-checklist.md): Verify source, package, plugin, and npm publish gates.
- [Execution quality register](quality/problem-register.md): Track the sanitized 41-item execution quality baseline and acceptance gates.

## Product rules

- Start from requirement sources when available.
- Do not execute before explicit approval.
- Keep requirement expectations, system observations, and execution results separate.
- Create a Gap when evidence is missing or ambiguous; do not invent business actions.
- Create a BugReport only for an evidence-backed business expectation mismatch.
- Prefer Facade MCP tools. Use low-level tools only for compatibility, audit, and debugging.
